findings.title: Net-cash understatement disclosed but not quantified; equity securities not covered by the robustness claim
findings.detail: valuation.json net_cash = cash 22,443m - debt 33,366m = -10,923m, with short_term_investments = 0 because the catalog concept MarketableSecuritiesCurrent is stale (latest 2025-10-26) and DebtSecuritiesCurrent / EquitySecuritiesFvNi have no observations in snapshot/facts.json (eu.py concepts: in_snapshot=false). The note discloses this correctly, but it does not give the omitted amounts. The balance sheet in periodic.txt (lines 263-265) shows marketable debt securities of 34,143m and marketable equity securities of 42,783m. The note's claim that including the debt securities would not change the rating holds: +34,143m / 24,285m diluted shares = +$1.41 per share in both the DCF and the relative leg, so the blended value is about $185.5 (target $186, upside about -11.3%). The note does not test the equity securities as well. Including both (+76,926m, +$3.17 per share) gives a blended value of about $187.3 (target about $187, upside about -10.8%). That is still Underperform, but only about 0.8 pts from the -10% band edge. gen-mapping's own rationale said these amounts should be sourced from filing text downstream, and that was not done. Because the figure is labelled accurately and the rating does not change, this is minor.
findings.required_evidence: The Model and valuation judgment paragraph states the omitted amounts (marketable debt securities $34.1bn, marketable equity securities $42.8bn, from the filing text) and that including both still leaves upside below -10%, or the narrower thin-margin caveat is stated explicitly.

findings.title: Net cash described as 'cash and long-term debt' although the debt figure includes short-term debt
findings.detail: The note says 'The net cash figure counts only mapped cash and long-term debt.' The mapped total_debt concept is LongTermDebt = 33,366m, which equals short-term debt 1,000m plus long-term debt 32,366m (periodic.txt lines 299-303). That makes it total debt, as the mapping rationale says. The wording slightly misdescribes the value. It does not affect any figure.
findings.required_evidence: The note describes the debt deducted as total debt (short-term plus long-term).
